pages.title: Refunds & Returns
pages.body:
Made to your specification

Our made-to-measure curtains are made to your individual choices and measurements. The usual online change-of-mind cancellation right does not apply to goods made to your specifications or clearly personalised. A change of mind alone does not normally entitle you to return them. This does not remove your rights if goods are faulty, damaged, incorrect or materially not as described.

Requesting a change

Need to request a change? Email us within 2 hours of placing your order at enquiries@curtainsuk.com. We’ll review your request and get in touch. This is a request window, not a statutory cancellation period or a promise that a change can be made. Please give your order number and the change you would like. We will review the request; changes may not be possible once processing or manufacture has begun.

Fabric samples

Fabric samples are separate from your made-to-measure curtains. We do not offer a voluntary change-of-mind return or refund for samples. This does not remove your rights where a sample is faulty, damaged, incorrect or materially not as described. Contact support@curtainsuk.com with your order details and useful photographs where appropriate.

Faulty, damaged or incorrect goods

Contact support@curtainsuk.com with your order number, a description of the problem and photographs if useful and possible. We may need to inspect the goods. Your legal remedies depend on the circumstances and may include a refund, repair or replacement. We do not impose a short reporting deadline that removes your statutory rights.

Refunds and return costs

Where a remedy is due, we will work with you on the appropriate repair, replacement or refund and normally use the original payment method. We do not impose an invented reporting deadline that removes statutory rights.

Colour and finish

Please read Fabric Colour, Shade & Variation and consider a physical sample before ordering. Normal material characteristics do not give us permission to supply the wrong fabric or goods materially different from their description.

Further help

If you are unhappy with how a return is handled, see Complaints. Your statutory rights are unaffected.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions
pages.body:
Who you are buying from

Apex Curtains Ltd trading as Curtains UK. Company number 15652466 (England and Wales).

Customer correspondence and authorised returns address: 36–44 Bolton Road, Blackburn, BB2 3FA.

For help before or after ordering, contact support@curtainsuk.com.

Choosing fabric and curtains

Our service helps you choose fabrics, order samples and configure made-to-measure curtains. Fabric Intelligence and Curtain Anatomy are aids to choosing: the neutral Anatomy studies are not exact previews of a purchasable fabric. Read Fabric Colour, Shade & Variation and check the fabric identity and specification before ordering.

Measurements

Follow Guided Measure using fitted hardware. Supply the raw width and drop requested for your setup. CurtainsUK applies the relevant workshop calculations later. Do not add heading, hook or fullness allowances yourself. If unsure, ask us before placing an order. Our review does not replace an on-site measurement service.

Checking your configuration

Check fabric, opening, hardware, heading, width, drop, lining and pair/single choices before continuing. A validated made-to-measure item is fixed in Shopify. To change it, remove it and configure your curtains again; the replacement is priced and checked afresh.

Price, payment and availability

Check the goods price, VAT treatment, delivery charge and total presented before payment. The made-to-measure service recalculates the price and checks current fabric eligibility and stock before creating checkout. If a supply problem arises after payment, CurtainsUK will contact you about the available resolution. We will not substitute a different fabric without your agreement.

After you order

Payment sends your made-to-measure order to CurtainsUK review. It does not automatically approve manufacture or release it to the workroom. See Your made-to-measure order for the steps.

Workmanship

CurtainsUK strives for high standards of workmanship. Where a genuine workmanship or manufacturing defect is identified, we will work with you to rectify and resolve the issue appropriately. We do not offer a fixed-duration warranty in this notice; statutory rights remain unaffected.

Changes, cancellation and problems

Need to request a change? Email us within 2 hours of placing your order at enquiries@curtainsuk.com. We’ll review your request and get in touch. Requested changes are subject to review and are not guaranteed. See Refunds & Returns for the distinction between made-to-measure goods, samples and goods that are faulty or not as described.

Delivery

Read Delivery Information and the delivery information provided with your order. If delivery or supply cannot proceed as agreed, contact us to discuss your order and legal remedies.

Your rights and complaints

Nothing in these terms excludes or restricts consumer rights or liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. For complaints contact complaints@curtainsuk.com. Changes to these terms will not retrospectively remove rights under an existing order.

pages.body:
Who is responsible

Apex Curtains Ltd trading as Curtains UK. Company number 15652466 (England and Wales).

Customer correspondence and authorised returns address: 36–44 Bolton Road, Blackburn, BB2 3FA.

Contact support@curtainsuk.com with privacy questions or requests. Please do not send payment card details or unnecessary sensitive information.

Fabric Intelligence

We process the preferences and room information you provide, colour observations, your palette edits and reactions, recommendations, and consultation identifiers. Automated analysis and recommendation processing help suggest fabrics. You decide what to choose; recommendations do not commit you to an order. Consultation records and related events are stored by the CurtainsUK service so the experience can continue and be supported.

Room and reference images

An image is optional and is used only to provide the Fabric Intelligence service you request. We do not use uploaded room images for model training, general AI training, product or model improvement, unrelated evaluation or research, marketing, or a reusable image dataset. Our current consultation database rejects raw image data and stores derived observations and preferences instead. The upstream processor, temporary handling, logs, backups, deletion behaviour and international processing are being verified before precise operational promises are made. Please do not include identifiable people, documents, addresses or other unnecessary personal details. See Room Image & AI Privacy.

Guided Measure

Guided Measure saves entered measurements, setup, progress, earlier readings and confirmed briefs in local storage in your browser. They remain on that device until cleared or replaced by the tool/browser. Confirming a brief does not itself make it a production specification. Measurements you later submit in Make Curtains become part of the order configuration and review record.

Samples and made-to-measure orders

We use the contact and delivery details you provide to handle sample orders and curtain orders. Curtain records include the fabric, options, raw measurements, price and review/production history. Payment status and order information are available to us through Shopify. Payment card information is handled by Shopify and the payment service used at checkout; our curtain configuration service does not request full card details.

Support, complaints and media

We use your correspondence and relevant order or enquiry information to answer you and handle any problem. Customer support, complaints, media enquiries and order-change requests have separate contact routes. Records may be needed to follow up your case, meet legal obligations or resolve a dispute.

Purposes and legal bases

Order fulfilment and steps you request before buying use the contract basis. Applicable accounting and other statutory records use the legal-obligation basis. Service security, fraud prevention and handling routine enquiries may rely on legitimate interests, subject to your rights. Where processing requires consent, including non-exempt optional tracking, consent must be obtained and may be withdrawn.

Service providers

Shopify provides the storefront, checkout and related order services. The current CurtainsUK backend uses Vercel for hosting and Supabase for application records, with a separate image/recommendation service. Payment, delivery and manufacturing providers receive information needed for their role. The complete processor list, subprocessors and image-provider arrangements remain subject to technical and contractual verification before this notice is released.

Shopify Network Intelligence

Shopify Network Intelligence is enabled in this store. Shopify describes this as using customer data with data from other Shopify merchants to support features including advertising and personalisation. Read Shopify’s Privacy Policy for its processing and rights information.

Cookies and browser storage

Read Cookie Information for cookies, local storage and saved choices. Cookie Settings opens the Shopify preferences control once configured. Clearing browser storage can remove a saved consultation or measurement brief; it does not erase order records already submitted to us.

Retention and international processing

We must keep information only for the purposes and periods justified by our service and legal obligations. The record-specific retention schedule, processor deletion arrangements and applicable safeguards for international transfers require confirmation. Shopify Admin currently lists the European Union as the primary data-hosting location; this does not prove that every service or transfer is confined to the EU.

Your rights

Depending on the circumstances, you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to use of your information. Where consent applies, you can withdraw it. Email support@curtainsuk.com; we may need to check your identity. You can also raise a concern with the Information Commissioner’s Office.

Cookies and saved choices

Analytics and marketing

pages.title: Fabric Colour, Shade & Variation
pages.body:
See it in your own light

Screens, camera exposure and image processing can change how colour appears. Daylight, lamps and neighbouring wall or furnishing colours can also affect how a fabric looks in your room. Where colour, texture or finish matters, order a physical sample and look at it in the room at different times.

Texture, weave and direction

A woven surface, raised yarn or nap can catch light differently as it turns or hangs. Some materials have natural irregularities. The relevant characteristics depend on the particular fabric; not every fabric has a nap or natural variation. Ask for product-specific information if you are unsure.

Samples and later batches

A small sample cannot show every part of a large pattern or the full effect of folds. Dye batches can differ, so a sample or earlier order should not be treated as a guarantee of an identical later batch. Please ask about a critical match before ordering.

Pattern and the finished curtain

Pattern repeat and placement affect what is visible across a panel and through its folds. Photography and educational form studies are not promises of a particular motif position on your order. Ask us to review any essential placement requirement before buying.

Fabric Intelligence and colour families

Fabric Intelligence, Fabric Knowledge and colour-family swatches help you compare and describe colour. They are interpretations and screen representations, not calibrated proofs of the physical cloth. A room photograph also reflects its lighting and camera settings.

Your rights

This guidance does not excuse faulty goods, an incorrect fabric or goods materially not as described. See Refunds & Returns or contact support@curtainsuk.com.

Before you upload

Adding a room or reference image is optional. Fabric Intelligence can use an uploaded image to help interpret colours and suggest fabric directions. Please avoid including people, addresses, documents or other unnecessary personal information in the image.

How the consultation uses your image

The image and your consultation input are processed to provide the Fabric Intelligence service you request. You can review and correct colour interpretation, or use the questions and Browse Fabrics without uploading an image.

Training and stored consultation information

The CurtainsUK integration is configured with training permission disabled for uploaded room images. It is also designed not to store raw reference media in the consultation state. Derived information can include colour observations, your confirmed palette, answers, reactions, recommendations and an image hash.

If you need current details about temporary processor handling, retention or international processing before uploading an image, contact support@curtainsuk.com.

Questions and rights

Contact support@curtainsuk.com with your consultation reference where available. Please do not attach the original image again just to request help. You can also read our Privacy Policy.

pages.title: Your made-to-measure order
pages.body:
From order to curtain

Order placed and paid → CurtainsUK review → Approved for manufacture → Production/workroom → Delivery. Payment does not automatically approve manufacture or release your order to the workroom.

What we review

Your fabric and configuration are recorded together with the measurements and validated price. Workshop-derived manufacturing dimensions are a separate production step. If we need clarification, CurtainsUK will contact you.

Want to change something?

Need to request a change? Email us within 2 hours of placing your order at enquiries@curtainsuk.com. We’ll review your request and get in touch. Requests are reviewed and changes are not guaranteed. This request window does not replace statutory rights.

Before you pay

A configured curtain is fixed in your cart/checkout. Keep it, or remove it and configure your curtains again. Continue shopping takes you to Browse Fabrics without clearing retained cart items.

Help after ordering

Contact support@curtainsuk.com with your order number. See Refunds & Returns and Delivery Information.

pages.title: Complaints
pages.body:
Tell us what happened

Email complaints@curtainsuk.com. Include your name, order/reference number if relevant, what happened, any useful dates and the resolution you would like. Photographs can help with a product issue, but please avoid including unnecessary personal information.

How we handle it

We will review the information, ask for clarification if needed, and explain the outcome and any proposed next steps. If you disagree with the response, reply with the points you would like reconsidered.

Your rights

This process does not limit your statutory rights or prevent you seeking independent advice. We do not claim membership of an alternative dispute resolution scheme. Privacy concerns can also be raised with the ICO.

Our approach

Forced labour, slavery, servitude and human trafficking are not acceptable in how CurtainsUK aims to operate. This page is not presented as a statutory annual modern slavery statement.

Raise a supply-chain concern

Customers, workers and business partners can raise a concern through complaints@curtainsuk.com. Avoid sharing information that could put somebody at risk. If someone is in immediate danger, contact the emergency services.

What we claim

We do not claim a formal supplier-audit, certification or training programme on this page. If a particular sourcing assurance or certification matters to your purchase, contact support@curtainsuk.com before ordering so the available evidence can be checked.

Packaging and product materials

pages.title: Website Accessibility
pages.body:
Using the website

We want CurtainsUK to be usable with a keyboard, screen reader and mobile device. The shared footer uses named navigation groups, visible focus and expandable sections on small screens. We are reviewing accessibility across the wider service.

If something gets in your way

Email support@curtainsuk.com with the page address, what you were trying to do, and the browser or assistive technology if you know it. Tell us what alternative format or help would work for you.

Current scope

This is an accessibility information page, not a claim of formal WCAG certification. Shopify checkout and third-party services have separate interfaces. We record known issues and improvements rather than claiming that every journey has passed a full accessibility audit.

pages.title: Delivery Information
pages.body:
Before ordering

CurtainsUK currently delivers to UK Mainland. Check the delivery area, current charge and timing supplied for your order before payment. Samples are delivered free. Samples and made-to-measure curtains are different order types and may travel separately.

Made-to-measure curtains

Made-to-measure curtains normally take approximately 3–4 weeks, presented as an estimate rather than an absolute guarantee. Your paid order goes through CurtainsUK review and approval for manufacture before workroom release. Payment alone does not mean your curtains are in production. Contact support@curtainsuk.com with your order reference for help.

Receiving your order

The delivery charge for curtain orders is the current checkout delivery rule and may change; it is shown before payment. If goods arrive damaged, incorrect or incomplete, contact support@curtainsuk.com as soon as reasonably possible with your order details and useful photographs where appropriate. Read Refunds & Returns; this guidance does not limit your legal rights.

pages.title: Curtain Care & Cleaning
pages.body:
Start with your specific fabric

Use the care information supplied for your chosen fabric and finished curtain. Face fabric, lining, interlining, trims and hardware can have different requirements. A method suitable for one material may not suit the complete curtain.

Before cleaning

Check the supplied label or ask support@curtainsuk.com with your order/fabric reference. Do not assume a curtain is washable, suitable for tumble drying or suitable for a particular solvent. Seek specialist curtain-cleaning advice if the instructions are unclear.

Looking after the surface

Consider Fabric Colour, Shade & Variation when assessing nap, weave, shade or surface changes. Report damage or a suspected fault through Refunds & Returns.

pages.title: FAQs
pages.body:
How do I measure?

Use Guided Measure with your track or pole already fitted. It shows the correct tape anchors for your setup. If unsure, pause and contact us.

Can I try the fabric?

Order a £2.50 fabric sample from an eligible fabric in Browse Fabrics, Fabric Detail or Fabric Intelligence. A sample helps you judge the surface and colour in your room.

Can I edit a curtain in my cart?

No. Keep the configured curtain or remove it and configure again. This keeps fabric, measurements and price together. Continue shopping returns to Browse Fabrics without clearing retained items.

What happens after payment?

Your made-to-measure order goes to CurtainsUK review. Approval and workroom release are separate staff actions. Read Your made-to-measure order.

How do I request a change?

Need to request a change? Email us within 2 hours of placing your order at enquiries@curtainsuk.com. We’ll review your request and get in touch.

Can I return my order?

The rules differ for samples, made-to-measure goods and goods with a problem. See Refunds & Returns.
